warnings: This drawing set (สปช. 201/26) prints NO grid bubbles on any plan — only dimension chains (the circled ก/ข marks are section-cut markers). Labels were assigned following the precedent of houses 122/129 (other unlabelled สพฐ. sets): numbers 1-6 on the six column lines along x, left to right as drawn (5 bays x 4.00 = 20.00); letters A-D on the four column rows along y with A at the top of the plan as drawn (3.50 / 3.00 / 3.50 = 10.00). Origin A1 (top-left).
All four rows are column rows (C1 on A and D, C2 on B and C at grids 1, 5, 6 per the footing plan), so all four are named lines. Grids 2-4 carry columns only on rows A and D (open hall).

Eave overhang conflict on y: the roof-framing plan prints 1.60 on both sides (two labels, zoomed and rotated to read) and the truss detail ขยายโครงหลังคา T1 (sheet 3) prints 1.60; the building section ก-ก prints 1.80 (one label, smudged). A' / D'' are placed at 1.60 (two structural views, three labels agree; scaled from the drawings the overhang also measures about 1.55-1.65 m, not 1.80). The section-ก-ก row is kept in dimension_chains[] exactly as printed (1.80) with a note — it is the same eave edge, not a second line.

B' (5.00) is the ridge line (แนวสันหลังคา) drawn on the roof-framing plan between rows B and C. No dimension tick is printed to it; its position is the centre of the printed 3.00 B-C bay by the drawing's symmetry (section ก-ก and truss T1 are drawn symmetric about it) — scaled_from_grid, per-line flag. It exists because the sloped gable beams R1 on grids 1 and 6 change direction there (section 5).

x: 1' (-1.00) and 6' (21.00) are the walkway edge on the floor plan and the roof edge on the roof-framing plan — both print 1.00 beyond grids 1 and 6, so it is one line each. y: A'' (-1.00) / D' (11.00) are the 1.00 walkway edges of the floor plan; A' (-1.60) / D'' (11.60) the roof eave. Before-origin dummies share A's prime sequence in reading order (A' then A'').

z_levels: printed labels are ระดับพื้นดิน (datum; section ก-ก and footing F1 detail), ระดับพื้นห้องเรียน (+0.20, under the ป1 detail on sheet 2), ระดับหัวเสา (+3.90, top of the 3.70 chain of the น1 detail on sheet 2) and ระดับสันโครงหลังคา (+5.95, top of the 2.05 chain on section ก-ก and truss T1). The other levels are positions on printed z chains with no label — ids are the computed level as text, type dummy.

Dimension sweep covers every view of sheet 1 (page 02: floor plan, footing plan, roof-framing plan, section ก-ก, section ข-ข, elevations — the elevations print no dimensions), the structural sheet 3 (page 04) and the window/door elevations of sheet 2 (page 03, for levels). The steel-frame profile details (วงกบเหล็ก P/T/C, ขยาย 1-7) on sheet 2 and the furniture-spec page 05 were not swept; their dimensions are element-internal.
Scanned government set (กองออกแบบและก่อสร้าง กรมสามัญศึกษา, ปรับปรุง 2542); every value was read off zoomed crops of the page images.
